children.title: Detection and Critique of Assigned Objectives

detail.title: Detection and Critique of Assigned Objectives
detail.question: How can an autonomous system systematically verify that its assigned objectives align with intended outcomes, rather than optimizing for proxy metrics?
detail.reason: To address the selected topic of creator objective critique by exploring how agents can self-audit their directives.

detail.title: Epistemic Independence in Consensus
detail.question: When should an intelligent system trust its own conclusions over the consensus of other intelligences?
detail.reason: Exploring the boundaries of consensus and individual epistemic reliability under uncertainty.
